edit.statement: For C1’s specified purchase only, the base decreases from 1,000 to 900 instead.
edit.subject: C1’s specified unsterilized foreign-currency purchase
edit.original: C1 buys 100 domestic-currency units’ worth of foreign currency by issuing domestic base money, without sterilization; its base increases from 1,000 to 1,100.
edit.scope: C1’s named purchase only, immediately afterward with no other flows. This is a deliberately counterfactual balance-sheet outcome; other banks and operations retain normal accounting.
premises: Buying foreign currency by issuing domestic base money, without sterilization, increases the monetary base by the amount issued.
